logid.description: Log entry ID. Only present if requested with the ids prop.

ns.description: Namespace of the target page. Only present if requested with the title prop.

title.description: Prefixed title of the target page. Only present if requested with the title prop.

pageid.description: ID of the page that has the target title now, 0 if there is none. Only present if requested with the ids prop.

logpage.description: ID of the target page when the entry was made, 0 if there was none. Only present if requested with the ids prop.

revid.description: ID of the revision the entry is about, if there is one. Only present if requested with the ids prop.

params.description: Parameters of the log entry, as formatted by the log type. Only present if requested with the details prop.

type.description: Log type. Only present if requested with the type prop.

action.description: Log action. Only present if requested with the type prop.

user.description: Name of the user who made the entry. Only present if requested with the user prop.

userid.description: ID of the user who made the entry, 0 for an anonymous user. Only present if requested with the userid prop.

anon.description: Present, and true, if the user is anonymous.

temp.description: Present, and true, if the user is a temporary account.

timestamp.description: Time of the entry, in ISO 8601 format. Only present if requested with the timestamp prop.

comment.description: Log comment. Only present if requested with the comment prop.

parsedcomment.description: Log comment, as HTML. Only present if requested with the parsedcomment prop.

tags.description: Tags of the entry. Only present if requested with the tags prop.

actionhidden.description: Present, and true, if the log action is hidden.

userhidden.description: Present, and true, if the user is hidden.

commenthidden.description: Present, and true, if the comment is hidden.

suppressed.description: Present, and true, if hidden parts of the entry are suppressed.
